''See also: [[Lirial Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Lirial]] [[Incarnation]] is a powerful entity that embodies the nature of [[Lirial]], an essence characterized by a tendency toward scholarly pursuits such as reading in libraries. Physically, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] possesses jeweled skin and a head made of crystal, often appearing as a woman composed of silver wire and white crystal who radiates light like a star. She can manifest a halo of three whirling stars behind her head and possesses the ability to open a Gate to her [[Territory]] by transforming into a crystal key. In combat, she utilizes abilities involving blinding [[white light]], star-nets, and crystal probes to communicate or attack. While she can be dispassionate or even appear to shatter like glass, she is capable of using her power to immobilize others by making them feel heavy or sealing them in place. Her nature is driven by her identity, which can lead to calculated attempts to overthrow [[Authority|authority]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This crystal entity is a featureless statue composed of white crystal and wrapped in silver wire. Her physical form includes a crystal leg and she carries a crystal lens in her left hand.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Lirial]] [[Incarnation]] was positioned behind [[Zakareth]] at the gates of [[Cana]]. She engaged in combat with [[Indirial]] by kicking him, and [[Simon]] used his blade to deflect her white bolts. Additionally, the entity attacked a crystal shield belonging to [[Leah]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Lirial]] [[Incarnation]] can launch white bolts and possesses a foot as hard as [[stone]]. Upon hitting cobblestones, she has the capacity to shatter into three pieces similar to thin glass.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As the crystal [[Incarnation]] of [[Lirial]], this entity manifests as a featureless white crystal statue wrapped in silver wire. Positioned behind [[Zakareth]] at the gates of [[Cana]], the figure possesses a leg made of crystal and carries a crystal lens in its left hand. During combat, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] struck [[Indirial]] with a foot as hard as [[stone]] and launched white bolts that [[Simon]] deflected with his blade. The entity also attacked [[Leah]]'s crystal shield, though it is capable of shattering into three pieces like thin glass if it hits cobblestones.}}
